fields.Name: Order Booking
fields.Description: Written when an order line is confirmed (orders D10): one entry per line, debiting the receivable and crediting revenue or deferred revenue, with any discount to its contra account. Seeded by bizapps-orders because the EVENT is an orders concept - accounting seeds only the ledger-mechanics types it originates itself.

fields.Name: Revenue Recognition
fields.Description: A forward-dated release of deferred revenue (orders D14). Written AT BOOKING for every future period rather than by a scheduler, so the whole obligation is visible in the ledger the day the order is confirmed.

fields.Name: Payment Receipt
fields.Description: Written when a payment allocation books the cash leg (orders D13): debits cash and clears the receivable of whichever company owns the line the money settles. On a multi-company order this is one entry per company plus the intercompany legs.

fields.Name: Refund
fields.Description: The MIRROR of a capture (orders D53) - the same accounts with debit and credit swapped, at positive amounts. Never a negated original: accounting refuses a line with a negative debit, and a mirrored entry is also what an auditor expects to see.
